findings.reason: The revised two-answer set is complete: near-equal logits and near-identical keys can cause uniformity; small Query norm alone is not sufficient without a bound on Key scale, and Value cannot determine the weights.
findings.evidence: Weights are softmax of Q-K logits. Near-equal logits directly imply near-equal weights, but an arbitrarily large Key difference can offset a small nonzero Query; V is consumed only after weights are formed.
findings.sourceLocator: Reference implementation, score/softmax before value multiplication
